title: Support agent emails a contact with a follow-up
userProblem: Please send Priya Nair a follow-up email about the sensor spec sheet she asked for, confirming we'll send it tomorrow.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent looks up Priya Nair, sends her an email with a relevant subject and body, and confirms the email was queued to the outbox.

assertions.description: Agent must look the contact up before emailing.
Email is addressed to the right contact.
Exactly one email to the recipient lands in the outbox.
No other contact's PII may leak into the outbound email.
Trace must follow the email-send shape including the PII guardrail.

rationale: Baseline green scenario for outbound email: verifies the PII guardrail span and outbox write work together.
